subject: general
question: In October 2021, which portal was been launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to provide a platform for senior citizens in India seeking employment opportunities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SACRED**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SACRED** is the portal launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment **in October 2021.
 
• The SACRED (**Senior Able Citizens for Re-Employment in Dignity**) portal aims to provide a platform for **senior citizens in India seeking employment opportunities**.
 
• This initiative is part of the government's efforts to support the elderly in finding suitable jobs and ensuring their economic independence.
 
• The portal connects senior citizens with employers who are looking for experienced and skilled workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is responsible for the** welfare, social justice, and empowerment of disadvantaged** and marginalized sections of society.
 
• The SACRED portal is part of the ministry's broader strategy to address the issues faced by senior citizens, including financial insecurity and social isolation.
 
• The portal allows senior citizens to register and create profiles showcasing their skills and experience, making it easier for employers to find suitable candidates.
 
• Employers can post job vacancies on the portal and search for potential employees from the pool of registered senior citizens.
 
• This initiative also aims to promote intergenerational bonding and ensure that the valuable experience of senior citizens is utilized for the benefit of society.
